The Price of Ingenuity#407.src: ...if you say so, Yusanu. Still, I'd rather be out of here quickly.
The Price of Ingenuity#407.dst: ...sen öyle diyorsan, Yusanu. Yine de buradan çabucak çıkmayı tercih ederim.
The Price of Ingenuity#407.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#408.src: Yeah... same. Let's take the device and go.
The Price of Ingenuity#408.dst: Evet... ben de. Cihazı alıp gidelim.
The Price of Ingenuity#408.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#409.src: This is Soosu's favorite room in the workshop. Her golem creation room.
The Price of Ingenuity#409.dst: Burası Soosu'nun atölyedeki en sevdiği oda. Golem yapım odası.
The Price of Ingenuity#409.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#410.src: She... told me once that she likes working with plants. It's why a lot of her golems are built off of flower pots and soil.
The Price of Ingenuity#410.dst: Bir keresinde... bitkilerle çalışmayı sevdiğini söylemişti. Golemlerinin çoğunun saksı ve topraktan yapılmasının sebebi bu.
The Price of Ingenuity#410.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#411.src: Hm. Well, good thing she's using her blessing on this, and not... I don't know. Reshaping the whole world?
The Price of Ingenuity#411.dst: Hmm. Eh, iyi ki kutsamasını bunun için kullanıyor da... ne bileyim. Bütün dünyayı yeniden şekillendirmek için değil?
The Price of Ingenuity#411.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#412.src: A-another golem? Should we turn back?
The Price of Ingenuity#412.dst: B-bir golem daha mı? Geri mi dönsek?
The Price of Ingenuity#412.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#413.src: Oh, hey, it's Flowers! That's Soosu's favourite golem! Wonder why he's sleeping here and not on his Flowersbed, though. ... I wasn't the one that named that.
The Price of Ingenuity#413.dst: Aa, bak, bu Flowers! Soosu'nun en sevdiği golem! Gerçi neden Flowersbed'inde değil de burada uyuyor, merak ettim. ... Adını ben koymadım bu arada.
The Price of Ingenuity#413.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#414.src: Finally!!! He said yes!!! Uncle T finally let me visit his workshop, I'm so excited!!!!
The Price of Ingenuity#414.dst: Sonunda!!! Evet dedi!!! T Amca sonunda atölyesine gelmeme izin verdi, çok heyecanlıyım!!!!
The Price of Ingenuity#414.speaker: 125 NA

The Price of Ingenuity#415.src: He's real!! Flowers is REAL NOW!!!! I showed Ma my drawing, and she helped me sew him together!! Now I can match with Fiona! She has Daruma, and I have... Flowers!
The Price of Ingenuity#415.dst: Gerçek oldu!! Flowers artık GERÇEK!!!! Anneme çizimimi gösterdim, onu dikmeme yardım etti!! Artık Fiona'yla aynıyız! Onun Daruma'sı var, benim de... Flowers'ım!
The Price of Ingenuity#415.speaker: 125 NA

The Price of Ingenuity#416.src: Hmph. Hmph!!!!!!! Fiona's old enough now, she's gotta work too... she's always so tired now, she won't play with me anymore!!!! This sucks. This sucks!!!!
The Price of Ingenuity#416.dst: Hıh. Hıh!!!!!!! Fiona artık büyüdü, onun da çalışması lazımmış... hep çok yorgun, artık benimle oynamıyor!!!! Bu berbat. Berbat!!!!
The Price of Ingenuity#416.speaker: 126 NA

The Price of Ingenuity#417.src: Uncle T agreed to help me make the super ultra cow milker o-matic!!
The Price of Ingenuity#417.dst: T Amca süper ultra otomatik inek sağma makinesini yapmama yardım etmeyi kabul etti!!
The Price of Ingenuity#417.speaker: 126 NA

The Price of Ingenuity#419.src: Grrrrrr............ I haven't written in AGES......... and it's because I gotta WORK!!!! In the FIELDS!!!!
The Price of Ingenuity#419.dst: Grrrrrr............ ÇOK UZUN zamandır yazmadım......... çünkü ÇALIŞMAM lazım!!!! TARLADA!!!!
The Price of Ingenuity#419.speaker: 127 NA

The Price of Ingenuity#420.src: I've been READING!! Reading so so many books... about FARMING!
The Price of Ingenuity#420.dst: OKUYORUM!! Bir sürü bir sürü kitap okuyorum... ÇİFTÇİLİK hakkında!
The Price of Ingenuity#420.speaker: 128 NA

The Price of Ingenuity#421.src: It's that time of year again!! The FESTIVAL OF THE CROWN!!! Just a week away!!!
The Price of Ingenuity#421.dst: Yılın o zamanı geldi yine!! TAÇ FESTİVALİ!!! Sadece bir hafta kaldı!!!
The Price of Ingenuity#421.speaker: 128 NA

The Price of Ingenuity#422.src: Weird thing happened today. Uncle T came home with a strange man from the military, big ol fancy uniform and all!
The Price of Ingenuity#422.dst: Bugün tuhaf bir şey oldu. T Amca ordudan garip bir adamla eve geldi, kocaman süslü üniformasıyla falan!
The Price of Ingenuity#422.speaker: 128 NA

The Price of Ingenuity#423.src: It turns out, the Crown really liked my super duper farmer!! Cause it makes it easier to harvest crops and stuff, they want us to make more of them, so everyone can do their work faster!!!
The Price of Ingenuity#423.dst: Meğer Taç benim süper muhteşem çiftçimi çok beğenmiş!! Çünkü mahsul toplamayı falan kolaylaştırıyormuş, daha çok yapmamızı istiyorlar, herkes işini daha hızlı yapsın diye!!!
The Price of Ingenuity#423.speaker: 128 NA

The Price of Ingenuity#424.src: Ugh...... ughhhhhhhh......... UGHHHHHHH...... I'm so TIRED!!!
The Price of Ingenuity#424.speaker: 128 NA

The Price of Ingenuity#425.src: Uncle T got really hurt today. Really, really, really hurt.
The Price of Ingenuity#425.dst: T Amca bugün çok kötü yaralandı. Çok, çok, çok kötü.
The Price of Ingenuity#425.speaker: 129 NA

The Price of Ingenuity#426.src: Ma says Uncle T's gonna be okay. He will.
The Price of Ingenuity#426.dst: Annem T Amca'nın iyileşeceğini söylüyor. İyileşecek.
The Price of Ingenuity#426.speaker: 129 NA

The Price of Ingenuity#429.src: The Citadel was AWESOME!!! I've always dreamed of going up there, someday... and now I HAVE!!
The Price of Ingenuity#429.dst: Citadel MUHTEŞEMDİ!!! Hep bir gün oraya çıkmayı hayal ederdim... ve şimdi ÇIKTIM!!
The Price of Ingenuity#429.speaker: 129 NA

The Price of Ingenuity#430.src: Work on project E-lec-tricity is ongoing (yes, the name changed... the Sovereign didn't like what I called it before...... bleh.), and it's going really well!!
The Price of Ingenuity#430.dst: E-lek-trik projesi üzerinde çalışmalar sürüyor (evet, adı değişti... Hükümdar önceki adını beğenmedi...... ıyy.) ve çok iyi gidiyor!!
The Price of Ingenuity#430.speaker: 129 NA

The Price of Ingenuity#431.src: OKAY!!! DO NOT PANIC!!!! BUT THINGS! ARE! HAPPENING!!!!
The Price of Ingenuity#431.dst: TAMAM!!! PANİK YAPMA!!!! AMA BİR ŞEYLER! OLUYOR!!!!
The Price of Ingenuity#431.speaker: 130 NA

The Price of Ingenuity#433.src: Looking back at these entries, I... I feel hollow.
The Price of Ingenuity#433.dst: Bu yazılara dönüp bakınca... içimde bir boşluk hissediyorum.
The Price of Ingenuity#433.speaker: 3 IA

The Price of Ingenuity#434.src: Mother passed away from her illness, a few days ago. They knew it was coming for a while, apparently, but... it was still a shock.
The Price of Ingenuity#434.dst: Annem birkaç gün önce hastalığından öldü. Görünüşe göre bir süredir geleceğini biliyorlarmış, ama... yine de bir şok oldu.
The Price of Ingenuity#434.speaker: 4 IA

The Price of Ingenuity#435.src: What's the point in writing these, anymore? I don't know what to say. I could talk about my projects, about all the progress I've been making, but it all feels so hollow.
The Price of Ingenuity#435.dst: Artık bunları yazmanın ne anlamı var? Ne diyeceğimi bilmiyorum. Projelerimden, kaydettiğim onca ilerlemeden bahsedebilirim, ama hepsi çok boş geliyor.
The Price of Ingenuity#435.speaker: 10 IA

The Price of Ingenuity#436.src: How many years has it been? I can check the dates, but... I don't want to.
The Price of Ingenuity#436.dst: Kaç yıl oldu? Tarihlere bakabilirim, ama... istemiyorum.
The Price of Ingenuity#436.speaker: 40 IA

The Price of Ingenuity#437.src: Never forget, never stop creating, never give in!
The Price of Ingenuity#437.dst: Asla unutma, üretmeyi asla bırakma, asla pes etme!
The Price of Ingenuity#437.speaker: 45 IA

The Price of Ingenuity#438.src: And there it is... looking at it like this, it really is impressive.
The Price of Ingenuity#438.dst: İşte orada... böyle bakınca gerçekten etkileyici.
The Price of Ingenuity#438.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#439.src: Again, you really don't know what this is for? And more importantly, which of us will carry it out?
The Price of Ingenuity#439.dst: Yine soruyorum, bunun ne işe yaradığını gerçekten bilmiyor musun? Daha önemlisi, onu hangimiz dışarı taşıyacak?
The Price of Ingenuity#439.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#440.src: I'd say until we're in the clear, {u} should carry it. And no... I really, absolutely do not. Every time I've asked Soosu to elaborate, she's just blown me off.
The Price of Ingenuity#440.dst: Bence tehlikeden çıkana kadar {u} taşısın. Ve hayır... gerçekten, kesinlikle bilmiyorum. Soosu'ya her ayrıntı sorduğumda beni başından savdı.
The Price of Ingenuity#440.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#441.src: Well. Whatever this is, it can't be any good if the Crown wants it. {u}, are you ready?
The Price of Ingenuity#441.dst: Eh. Bu her neyse, Taç istiyorsa iyi bir şey olamaz. {u}, hazır mısın?
The Price of Ingenuity#441.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#442.src: Wait. Do you also hear that sound? Are those footsteps?
The Price of Ingenuity#442.dst: Dur. Sen de o sesi duyuyor musun? Ayak sesleri mi bunlar?
The Price of Ingenuity#442.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#443.src: Can't be anything else - and there's two pairs of them. So Soosu is here, but with whom...?
The Price of Ingenuity#443.dst: Başka bir şey olamaz - hem de iki kişi. Demek Soosu burada, ama kiminle...?
The Price of Ingenuity#443.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#444.src: ...are you sure this is the best idea? Dividing your attention between the discussion, and your...projects... It hasn't worked out in the past.
The Price of Ingenuity#444.dst: ...bunun en iyi fikir olduğundan emin misin? Dikkatini görüşmeyle... projelerin arasında bölmek... Geçmişte işe yaramadı.
The Price of Ingenuity#444.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Price of Ingenuity#445.src: Well, you know, Zhiraok, not eeeveryone seems to have the time to drop everything and leave their region. Sometimes, we have a job to do.
The Price of Ingenuity#445.dst: Eh, bilirsin Zhiraok, heeerkesin her şeyi bırakıp bölgesinden ayrılacak vakti yok gibi. Bazen yapmamız gereken bir iş olur.
The Price of Ingenuity#445.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#446.src: Ah, there you are, Flowers! Wakey wakey, sleepyhead - you've got some guarding to get back to!
The Price of Ingenuity#446.dst: Ah, işte buradasın, Flowers! Uyan uyan, uykucu - nöbetine dönmen lazım!
The Price of Ingenuity#446.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#448.src: Awareness, Soosu! A bit of warning before you stop like that?
The Price of Ingenuity#448.dst: Dikkat, Soosu! Öyle aniden durmadan önce biraz haber versene?
The Price of Ingenuity#448.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Price of Ingenuity#449.src: Hm? Ah, sorry, sorry, but an unexpected run-in with a close friend is just sooo nice! Surely there's space somewhere in your mind to know that, hmm?
The Price of Ingenuity#449.dst: Hm? Ah, pardon, pardon, ama yakın bir dostla beklenmedik karşılaşma çok güüüzel! Aklının bir köşesinde bunu bilecek yer vardır herhalde, hmm?
The Price of Ingenuity#449.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#450.src: Soosu... This is a solved problem! How many times have I told you that? ...Alright, look, that's a tangent. What I really need to tell you-
The Price of Ingenuity#450.dst: Soosu... Bu çözülmüş bir sorun! Sana kaç kere söyledim? ...Peki, bak, konu dağıldı. Sana asıl söylemem gereken-
The Price of Ingenuity#450.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Price of Ingenuity#451.src: Escape the workshop without being spotted.

The Price of Ingenuity#452.src: Soosu's here? And with Zhiraok, of all people?! We have to get out, now!
The Price of Ingenuity#452.dst: Soosu burada mı? Hem de Zhiraok'la, onca insan arasından?! Hemen çıkmamız lazım!
The Price of Ingenuity#452.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#453.src: Yeah, but I bet Soosu's got Flowers on high alert! Don't use your magic, and whatever you do, don't get spotted!
The Price of Ingenuity#453.dst: Evet, ama bahse girerim Soosu Flowers'ı tam alarma geçirmiştir! Büyünü kullanma, ne yaparsan yap, sakın görünme!
The Price of Ingenuity#453.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#454.src: Wait- What's that, Flowers? Intruders?! Right by the device room?!
The Price of Ingenuity#454.dst: Dur- O ne, Flowers? Davetsiz misafirler mi?! Hem de cihaz odasının hemen yanında mı?!
The Price of Ingenuity#454.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#455.src: ...!! The Cursed!! You're not laying one digit on her, you hear me?!
The Price of Ingenuity#455.dst: ...!! Lanetli!! Ona tek bir parmağını bile süremezsin, duydun mu?!
The Price of Ingenuity#455.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Price of Ingenuity#456.src: Wh-what the helix- Infiltrators! You aren't getting away this time!
The Price of Ingenuity#456.dst: N-ne integrali bu- Sızanlar! Bu sefer kaçamayacaksınız!
The Price of Ingenuity#456.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Price of Ingenuity#457.src: Yusanu?! Who is that with you? Wait, are you trying to steal the device?!
The Price of Ingenuity#457.dst: Yusanu?! Yanındaki kim? Dur, yoksa cihazı çalmaya mı çalışıyorsun?!
The Price of Ingenuity#457.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#458.src: Hello, we're meant to run! Are you even taking this seriously?!
The Price of Ingenuity#458.dst: Alo, kaçmamız lazım! Bunu ciddiye alıyor musun sen?!
The Price of Ingenuity#458.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#459.src: ...you're smart enough that I shouldn't need to reiterate this! I know you are! Please, take the problem seriously!
The Price of Ingenuity#459.dst: ...bunu tekrarlamama gerek kalmayacak kadar akıllısın! Biliyorum ki öylesin! Lütfen, sorunu ciddiye al!
The Price of Ingenuity#459.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Price of Ingenuity#460.src: A set of criminals is in your quadrant, the Cursed behind the Torann massacre is with them, they're infil-
The Price of Ingenuity#460.dst: Senin çeyreğinde bir grup suçlu var, Torann katliamının arkasındaki Lanetli de onlarla, sızıyorlar-
The Price of Ingenuity#460.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Price of Ingenuity#461.src: Oh my god, Z, I get it!!! All you do is yap yap yap yap YAP!!! Give me some room to think!!!
The Price of Ingenuity#461.dst: Aman tanrım, Z, anladım!!! Tek yaptığın vır vır vır vır VIR!!! Biraz düşünmeme izin ver!!!
The Price of Ingenuity#461.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#462.src: Bla bla criminals, bla bla cursed one, et cetera et cetera et cetera!!!! Yes, I know how important it is! Flowers, hold this steady for me, won't you?
The Price of Ingenuity#462.dst: Bla bla suçlular, bla bla lanetli, vesaire vesaire vesaire!!!! Evet, ne kadar önemli olduğunu biliyorum! Flowers, şunu benim için sabit tutar mısın?
The Price of Ingenuity#462.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#463.src: As long as your focus is on the solutions, not your... But, Soosu, I haven't heard anything from you. There was key information I had to learn offhand!
The Price of Ingenuity#463.dst: Odağın senin şu... değil de çözümler olduğu sürece... Ama Soosu, senden hiçbir şey duymadım. Önemli bilgileri tesadüfen öğrenmek zorunda kaldım!
The Price of Ingenuity#463.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Price of Ingenuity#464.src: One of your commanders summarized the topic for me. I should've heard it from you! So...what's your angle? It feels like you're ignoring the issue.
The Price of Ingenuity#464.dst: Komutanlarından biri konuyu bana özetledi. Bunu senden duymalıydım! Peki... niyetin ne? Sorunu görmezden geliyormuşsun gibi geliyor.
The Price of Ingenuity#464.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Price of Ingenuity#465.src: ...Soosu? Soosu, are you listening? I asked you a question!
The Price of Ingenuity#465.dst: ...Soosu? Soosu, dinliyor musun? Sana bir soru sordum!
The Price of Ingenuity#465.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Price of Ingenuity#466.src: Hm? Yeah, yeah, sure. Hey, could you fetch me some bolts?
The Price of Ingenuity#466.dst: Hm? Evet, evet, tabii. Hey, bana birkaç cıvata getirir misin?
The Price of Ingenuity#466.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#467.src: ...fine, sure- But please, we have to round this out, Soosu. You have to get involved.
The Price of Ingenuity#467.dst: ...peki, tamam- Ama lütfen, bunu bir sonuca bağlamamız lazım, Soosu. İşin içine girmen lazım.
The Price of Ingenuity#467.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Price of Ingenuity#468.src: Oh, right, about Flowers. Could you go check if his body picked up any parts while walking that I could use?
The Price of Ingenuity#468.dst: Ah, doğru, Flowers hakkında. Yürürken gövdesine kullanabileceğim bir parça takılmış mı, bakar mısın?
The Price of Ingenuity#468.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#469.src: I knew letting you work in here was irrational. There's such a greater sum of problems than your toys! You're acting like a child, but you aren't one!
The Price of Ingenuity#469.dst: Burada çalışmana izin vermenin irrasyonel olduğunu biliyordum. Oyuncaklarından çok daha büyük sorunlar var! Çocuk gibi davranıyorsun, ama çocuk değilsin!
The Price of Ingenuity#469.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Price of Ingenuity#470.src: I know you can do such good work if you just apply yourself! Why are you just ignoring a high-ranking defector and a Cursed exponentiating each others' threat?!
The Price of Ingenuity#470.dst: Kendini verirsen çok iyi işler çıkarabileceğini biliyorum! Birbirinin tehdidini katlayan üst düzey bir hainle bir Lanetliyi neden görmezden geliyorsun?!
The Price of Ingenuity#470.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Price of Ingenuity#471.src: Do you think you're better than me, Zhiraok?
The Price of Ingenuity#471.dst: Benden üstün olduğunu mu sanıyorsun, Zhiraok?
The Price of Ingenuity#471.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#472.src: Oh, look at Soosu, always so inattentive and clueless, always ignoring the needs of her district, always cooped up in her laboratory.
The Price of Ingenuity#472.dst: Aa, şu Soosu'ya bakın, hep dalgın ve bihaber, bölgesinin ihtiyaçlarını hep görmezden gelir, hep laboratuvarına kapanır.
The Price of Ingenuity#472.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#473.src: Who even cares about the work she does? The projects she's assigned?! Who even cares that she knows, she knows, she KNOWS!!!!
The Price of Ingenuity#473.dst: Yaptığı iş kimin umurunda ki? Verilen projeler?! Bildiği, bildiği, BİLDİĞİ kimin umurunda!!!!
The Price of Ingenuity#473.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#474.src: ...Hm! Maybe you are better, Z. If you weren't, maybe we wouldn't be here right now!!
The Price of Ingenuity#474.dst: ...Hm! Belki de gerçekten üstünsün, Z. Olmasaydın belki şu an burada olmazdık!!
The Price of Ingenuity#474.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#475.src: I... ... ...I'm sorry Soosu. That...that wasn't my angle, I didn't mean t-
The Price of Ingenuity#475.dst: Ben... ... ...Özür dilerim, Soosu. Benim... niyetim bu değildi, öyle demek iste-
The Price of Ingenuity#475.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Price of Ingenuity#476.src: But you did! Hand me cog C-{~}, would you?
The Price of Ingenuity#476.dst: Ama öyle dedin! C-{~} dişlisini uzatır mısın?
The Price of Ingenuity#476.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#477.src: ...alright. I just want to reach the end of this sequence as fast as possible.
The Price of Ingenuity#477.dst: ...peki. Sadece bu dizinin sonuna olabildiğince çabuk ulaşmak istiyorum.
The Price of Ingenuity#477.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Price of Ingenuity#478.src: That makes two of us. I'm working on it. You can stop bugging me about it!!
The Price of Ingenuity#478.dst: İkimiz de öyle. Üzerinde çalışıyorum. Bu konuda başımın etini yemeyi bırakabilirsin!!
The Price of Ingenuity#478.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#479.src: ...maybe I should've been paying more attention. I didn't realize her project was putting so much weight on your shoulders. And I promised to help, too...
The Price of Ingenuity#479.dst: ...belki daha dikkatli olmalıydım. Onun projesinin omuzlarına bu kadar yük bindirdiğini fark etmemiştim. Hem de yardım edeceğime söz vermiştim...
The Price of Ingenuity#479.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Price of Ingenuity#480.src: Preliminary results suggest significantly improved utilization of energy, and reduced pollution. (Cleaner air? May help.)
The Price of Ingenuity#480.dst: İlk sonuçlar enerjinin çok daha verimli kullanıldığını ve kirliliğin azaldığını gösteriyor. (Daha temiz hava? İşe yarayabilir.)

The Price of Ingenuity#482.src: Return to the Steel Feather through Yusanu's tunnel at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Price of Ingenuity#483.src: ...what was that?! What were they DOING there?!
The Price of Ingenuity#483.dst: ...o neydi öyle?! Onların orada ne İŞİ vardı?!
The Price of Ingenuity#483.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#484.src: I- I- I don't know! A surprise visit? I didn't... I didn't think...
The Price of Ingenuity#484.dst: B- b- bilmiyorum! Sürpriz bir ziyaret mi? Ben... aklıma gelmedi...
The Price of Ingenuity#484.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#485.src: So, "letting off some steam", huh?! Oh, sure, bring Sovereign Zhiraok along with you!! Why not!!!
The Price of Ingenuity#485.dst: Demek "stres atmak", ha?! Ah, tabii, yanında Hükümdar Zhiraok'u da getir!! Neden olmasın!!!
The Price of Ingenuity#485.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#486.src: We almost got caught! We- oh god, we... we almost got caught...
The Price of Ingenuity#486.dst: Az kalsın yakalanıyorduk! Biz- tanrım, biz... az kalsın yakalanıyorduk...
The Price of Ingenuity#486.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#487.src: ...what are we doing? Why did- why did we do that? That was so...
The Price of Ingenuity#487.dst: ...ne yapıyoruz biz? Neden- neden bunu yaptık? Çok...
The Price of Ingenuity#487.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#488.src: You're asking ME?! Yeah, Rex, why did we do that?!
The Price of Ingenuity#488.dst: BANA mı soruyorsun?! Evet, Rex, neden bunu yaptık?!
The Price of Ingenuity#488.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#489.src: Stop. Just... stop, for a second. I need to... think.
The Price of Ingenuity#489.dst: Dur. Sadece... bir saniye dur. Düşünmem... lazım.
The Price of Ingenuity#489.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#490.src: ...damn it. Damn it, damn it, damn it! Stupid, impulsive... ugh!!
The Price of Ingenuity#490.dst: ...kahretsin. Kahretsin, kahretsin, kahretsin! Aptal, düşüncesiz... of!!
The Price of Ingenuity#490.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#492.src: No, I... I'm not. I'm sorry, I- I should know better by now...
The Price of Ingenuity#492.dst: Hayır, ben... iyi değilim. Özür dilerim, b- bunu artık öğrenmiş olmam lazım...
The Price of Ingenuity#492.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#493.src: It... doesn't matter. It's too late to take it back. We can... we can use it as a trump card. Yusanu, please tell me you can figure out what it is.
The Price of Ingenuity#493.dst: Bu... önemli değil. Geri almak için çok geç. Onu... onu koz olarak kullanabiliriz. Yusanu, lütfen ne olduğunu çözebileceğini söyle.
The Price of Ingenuity#493.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#494.src: I... I don't know. I never got to work too closely with it, so... I have no idea what it is. If I work with it, maybe I can get somewhere. But...
The Price of Ingenuity#494.dst: Ben... bilmiyorum. Onunla hiç çok yakından çalışmadım, yani... ne olduğu hakkında hiçbir fikrim yok. Üzerinde çalışırsam belki bir yere varırım. Ama...
The Price of Ingenuity#494.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#495.src: Good enough, I guess. Come on, let's get back. I need to... find Mora. And you need to tell everyone what you've been up to.
The Price of Ingenuity#495.dst: Yeterli, herhalde. Hadi, geri dönelim. Benim... Mora'yı bulmam lazım. Senin de herkese neler çevirdiğini anlatman lazım.
The Price of Ingenuity#495.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#496.src: You collectively decide that leaving Flowers be is probably best for everyone involved.
The Price of Ingenuity#496.dst: Flowers'ı rahat bırakmanın herkes için en iyisi olduğuna hep birlikte karar veriyorsunuz.

The Price of Ingenuity#497.src: These vents are broken, and were blocked off for a reason. Proceeding further will be dangerous!
The Price of Ingenuity#497.dst: Bu havalandırmalar bozuk ve bir sebepten kapatılmış. Daha ileri gitmek tehlikeli olacak!

The Price of Ingenuity#498.src: ...so just hiding what we did today isn't an option?
The Price of Ingenuity#498.dst: ...yani bugün yaptığımızı saklamak seçenek değil mi?
The Price of Ingenuity#498.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#499.src: And let it come back to bite us later down the line? No thanks. Let's go.
The Price of Ingenuity#499.dst: Sonra dönüp başımıza bela olsun diye mi? Yok, sağ ol. Hadi gidelim.
The Price of Ingenuity#499.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#500.src: Really, Rex, are you... alright? I don't think I've ever seen-
The Price of Ingenuity#500.dst: Cidden, Rex, sen... iyi misin? Seni hiç böyle gördüğümü-
The Price of Ingenuity#500.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#501.src: Don't. Don't push it. Not right now.
The Price of Ingenuity#501.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#502.src: Hey! You three, where the heck have you been all day?!
The Price of Ingenuity#502.dst: Hey! Siz üçünüz, bütün gün neredeydiniz be?!
The Price of Ingenuity#502.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#504.src: Yes, it's rather curious! I happened to speak to Syndra, and apparently there were no such "important tasks" assigned to you! She seemed rather clueless about the whole matter!
The Price of Ingenuity#504.dst: Evet, epey merak uyandırıcı! Syndra ile konuşma fırsatım oldu, görünüşe bakılırsa size öyle "önemli işler" falan verilmemiş! Bütün meseleden pek bihaber görünüyordu!
The Price of Ingenuity#504.speaker: Mora

The Price of Ingenuity#506.src: You know what happened, Mora. I- I messed up. Again.
The Price of Ingenuity#506.dst: Ne olduğunu biliyorsun, Mora. B- ben batırdım. Yine.
The Price of Ingenuity#506.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#507.src: Huh? What do you mean, agai-
The Price of Ingenuity#507.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#508.src: Ah, Yuman, would you mind taking Yusanu along with you to go tell the others we'll be a little late to the meeting? I believe there will be some additional news today.
The Price of Ingenuity#508.dst: Ah, Yuman, Yusanu'yu da yanına alıp diğerlerine toplantıya biraz geç kalacağımızı söyler misin? Sanırım bugün bazı ek haberler olacak.
The Price of Ingenuity#508.speaker: Mora

The Price of Ingenuity#509.src: Uh... sure, I guess. Yus, can you tell me what's up while we walk?
The Price of Ingenuity#509.dst: Şey... tabii, herhalde. Yus, yürürken neler olduğunu anlatır mısın?
The Price of Ingenuity#509.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#512.src: It's... bad. We stole something important from the Sovereign's workshop. It's... a long story. Yusanu should tell his part of it. But...
The Price of Ingenuity#512.dst: Kötü... Hükümdarın atölyesinden önemli bir şey çaldık. Uzun... hikâye. Yusanu kendi kısmını anlatsın. Ama...
The Price of Ingenuity#512.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#513.src: I see. I apologize, Rex, I should have been more attentive.
The Price of Ingenuity#513.dst: Anlıyorum. Özür dilerim, Rex, daha dikkatli olmalıydım.
The Price of Ingenuity#513.speaker: Mora

The Price of Ingenuity#514.src: No! No, it's not your fault, I should have- I should have known I was being impulsive, I... I wasn't thinking straight.
The Price of Ingenuity#514.dst: Hayır! Hayır, senin suçun değil, ben- düşüncesizce davrandığımı fark etmeliydim, ben... aklım başımda değildi.
The Price of Ingenuity#514.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#515.src: Ah. Of course, you don't know. I should have informed you the last time this happened...
The Price of Ingenuity#515.dst: Ah. Tabii ya, sen bilmiyorsun. Geçen sefer bu olduğunda sana haber vermeliydim...
The Price of Ingenuity#515.speaker: Mora

The Price of Ingenuity#516.src: Rex has these... ah, "moods," sometimes, wherein she gets... overly excitable and impulsive. Many a time have they led her into trouble.
The Price of Ingenuity#516.dst: Rex'in bazen... ah, "hâlleri" olur, öyle zamanlarda... aşırı heyecanlı ve düşüncesiz olur. Bu hâller pek çok kez onun başını belaya soktu.
The Price of Ingenuity#516.speaker: Mora

The Price of Ingenuity#517.src: Ugh, I should know better by now! Especially here, especially now, when...
The Price of Ingenuity#517.dst: Of, bunu artık öğrenmiş olmam lazım! Hele burada, hele şimdi, tam da...
The Price of Ingenuity#517.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#518.src: Well, what is done is done, and nevertheless, we must press on. Let's join the others for the meeting. Syndra has something important to tell us.
The Price of Ingenuity#518.dst: Eh, olan oldu, ne olursa olsun devam etmeliyiz. Toplantı için diğerlerine katılalım. Syndra'nın bize söyleyeceği önemli bir şey var.
The Price of Ingenuity#518.speaker: Mora

The Price of Ingenuity#519.src: Attend the meeting in the Steel Feather at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Price of Ingenuity#520.src: There you are! Mora, Rex, what's going-
The Price of Ingenuity#520.dst: İşte buradasınız! Mora, Rex, neler oluyor-
The Price of Ingenuity#520.speaker: Syndra

The Price of Ingenuity#521.src: Syndra, I believe that can wait. We've, ah, held up dinner long enough, I believe. If everyone is here, we should begin. First- Yusanu, what was it you had to tell us?
The Price of Ingenuity#521.dst: Syndra, sanırım o bekleyebilir. Akşam yemeğini, ah, yeterince geciktirdik bence. Herkes buradaysa başlayalım. Önce- Yusanu, bize ne söyleyecektin?
The Price of Ingenuity#521.speaker: Quill

The Price of Ingenuity#522.src: ...sigh. Before I begin, I need to make it clear- I was doing what I thought was best for the Steel Feather.
The Price of Ingenuity#522.dst: ...of. Başlamadan önce şunu açıkça söylemeliyim- Steel Feather için en iyisi olduğunu düşündüğüm şeyi yapıyordum.
The Price of Ingenuity#522.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#523.src: Yeah, man, good start... really instills confidence.
The Price of Ingenuity#523.dst: Evet, dostum, güzel başlangıç... insana gerçekten güven veriyor.
The Price of Ingenuity#523.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#524.src: Yuman, please... let me get through this. Don't interrupt.
The Price of Ingenuity#524.dst: Yuman, lütfen... bitirmeme izin ver. Sözümü kesme.
The Price of Ingenuity#524.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#525.src: So. So, so,so... The... the reason the crown has left us alone down here is because I have been working with Sovereign Soosu.
The Price of Ingenuity#525.dst: Şey. Şey, şey, şey... Tacın... tacın bizi burada rahat bırakmasının sebebi Hükümdar Soosu ile çalışıyor olmam.
The Price of Ingenuity#525.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#527.src: The reason we've been able to stay under the radar for so long is because of this, Yulie.
The Price of Ingenuity#527.dst: Bu kadar uzun süre gözden uzak kalabilmemizin sebebi bu, Yulie.
The Price of Ingenuity#527.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#528.src: The reason we can live here, leave our home, make use of the city's electricity... it's because of my collaboration.
The Price of Ingenuity#528.dst: Burada yaşayabilmemizin, evimizden ayrılabilmemizin, şehrin elektriğini kullanabilmemizin... sebebi benim bu işbirliğim.
The Price of Ingenuity#528.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#529.src: She said she saw potential in me. Told me that if I helped her in her workshops, then... then you all would be safe down here.
The Price of Ingenuity#529.dst: Bende potansiyel gördüğünü söyledi. Atölyelerinde ona yardım edersem... hepinizin aşağıda güvende olacağını söyledi.
The Price of Ingenuity#529.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#530.src: I didn't tell anybody because I knew you wouldn't get it. You'd think it was stupid, and risky, and a bad idea. Working with... with someone responsible for our problems.
The Price of Ingenuity#530.dst: Kimseye söylemedim çünkü anlamayacağınızı biliyordum. Aptalca, riskli, kötü bir fikir derdiniz. Sorunlarımızdan sorumlu biriyle... çalışmak.
The Price of Ingenuity#530.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#531.src: And I knew it was risky. I did. But I thought that if I were to mess up, only I would be punished. You all would be safe.
The Price of Ingenuity#531.dst: Riskli olduğunu da biliyordum. Gerçekten. Ama bir hata yaparsam sadece benim cezalandırılacağımı düşündüm. Siz güvende olurdunuz.
The Price of Ingenuity#531.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#532.src: ...now. I understand emotions are running high right now. I would ask everyone to take a step back, think through it logically, and remain c-
The Price of Ingenuity#532.dst: ...şimdi. Şu an ortamın çok gergin olduğunu anlıyorum. Herkesten bir adım geri çekilmesini, mantıkla düşünmesini ve sakin kal-
The Price of Ingenuity#532.speaker: Quill

The Price of Ingenuity#533.src: Are you insane, Yusanu?! Of all the secrets you could have been keeping-
The Price of Ingenuity#533.dst: Aklını mı kaçırdın, Yusanu?! Saklayabileceğin onca sır varken-
The Price of Ingenuity#533.speaker: Yulie

The Price of Ingenuity#535.src: No, I don't think I will! Is that what the alarms were about? How long has this been going on? What was running through your head when you decided-
The Price of Ingenuity#535.dst: Hayır, bırakmayacağım! Alarmlar bu yüzden miydi? Ne zamandır sürüyor bu? Karar verirken kafanda ne geçiyordu-
The Price of Ingenuity#535.speaker: Yulie

The Price of Ingenuity#536.src: As if you haven't been doing the same thing this whole time! Trying to put all the weight on your own shoulders, not getting help from anyone else!!
The Price of Ingenuity#536.dst: Sanki sen bunca zamandır aynı şeyi yapmıyormuşsun gibi! Bütün yükü kendi omuzlarına almaya çalışıyorsun, kimseden yardım almıyorsun!!
The Price of Ingenuity#536.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#537.src: So- so, y'know, I'm a little mad. He should have talked to us about it! But... he's telling us now. He's asking for help now.
The Price of Ingenuity#537.dst: Yani- yani, bilirsin, biraz kızgınım. Bunu bizimle konuşmalıydı! Ama... şimdi anlatıyor. Şimdi yardım istiyor.
The Price of Ingenuity#537.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#538.dst: Ne yazık ki daha da kötüsü var.
The Price of Ingenuity#538.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#540.src: After yesterday's run-in with the soldiers... Soosu is demanding I hand over whoever's responsible. I... I can't do that.
The Price of Ingenuity#540.dst: Dün askerlerle yaşanan olaydan sonra... Soosu kim sorumluysa onu teslim etmemi istiyor. Ben... bunu yapamam.
The Price of Ingenuity#540.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#541.src: Rex and {u} caught me talking to her today. That's why... that's why I'm telling you.
The Price of Ingenuity#541.dst: Rex ve {u} bugün beni onunla konuşurken yakaladı. Bu yüzden... bu yüzden size anlatıyorum.
The Price of Ingenuity#541.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#542.src: ...yeah. I convinced him to stop working with her, and to tell you all about it.
The Price of Ingenuity#542.dst: ...evet. Onunla çalışmayı bırakmaya ve hepinize anlatmaya ikna ettim.
The Price of Ingenuity#542.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#543.src: We also... stole an important gadget she and Yusanu were working on. Something the Queen was very invested in.
The Price of Ingenuity#543.dst: Bir de... onunla Yusanu'nun üzerinde çalıştığı önemli bir aleti çaldık. Kraliçe'nin çok önem verdiği bir şeyi.
The Price of Ingenuity#543.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#544.src: I don't know what it is or what it does. I don't know what it's for. All I know is that the Queen needs it finished. It's all she's had Soosu working on for... months.
The Price of Ingenuity#544.dst: Ne olduğunu da, ne yaptığını da bilmiyorum. Ne işe yaradığını bilmiyorum. Tek bildiğim, Kraliçe'nin onun bitmesine ihtiyacı olduğu. Soosu'yu... aylardır sadece bununla uğraştırıyor.
The Price of Ingenuity#544.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#545.src: I'll try to figure out what it is in my spare time. Maybe it'll help us! I... hope it will.
The Price of Ingenuity#545.dst: Boş vakitlerimde ne olduğunu çözmeye çalışacağım. Belki bize yardımı dokunur! Ben... öyle umuyorum.
The Price of Ingenuity#545.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#546.src: Yulie, Yuman... I owe you a better apology. I can talk to you in private later, but... right now, we should continue with the meeting.
The Price of Ingenuity#546.dst: Yulie, Yuman... size daha düzgün bir özür borçluyum. Sonra sizinle baş başa konuşabilirim, ama... şimdi toplantıya devam etmeliyiz.
The Price of Ingenuity#546.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#548.src: ...that was certainly a lot. Fortunately, angering the Sovereign may not ultimately matter. If all goes according to plan... the crown will fall at the end of the festival.
The Price of Ingenuity#548.dst: ...epey bir şeydi bu. Neyse ki Hükümdarı kızdırmak sonunda önemli olmayabilir. Her şey plana göre giderse... taç festivalin sonunda düşecek.
The Price of Ingenuity#548.speaker: Syndra

The Price of Ingenuity#549.src: My goal, as always, has been to find a way to destroy the crown's influence and to free our province. I believe this upcoming festival is an opportunity to do just that.
The Price of Ingenuity#549.dst: Amacım her zamanki gibi tacın etkisini yok etmenin ve eyaletimizi özgürleştirmenin bir yolunu bulmaktı. Yaklaşan festivalin tam da bunun için bir fırsat olduğuna inanıyorum.
The Price of Ingenuity#549.speaker: Syndra

The Price of Ingenuity#550.src: During the Crown Festival, Her Majesty will die.
The Price of Ingenuity#550.speaker: Syndra

The Price of Ingenuity#551.src: Settle down, everyone, settle down! Please, allow Syndra to continue.
The Price of Ingenuity#551.dst: Sakin olun, herkes, sakin olun! Lütfen, Syndra devam etsin.
The Price of Ingenuity#551.speaker: Quill

The Price of Ingenuity#552.src: It will not be easy. But if we strike when her guard is down, and catch her by surprise, I believe it is possible.
The Price of Ingenuity#552.dst: Kolay olmayacak. Ama gardı düşükken saldırır ve onu gafil avlarsak bunun mümkün olduğuna inanıyorum.
The Price of Ingenuity#552.speaker: Syndra

The Price of Ingenuity#553.src: I'll be splitting you all into several groups, and will assign tasks that must be completed before the festival.
The Price of Ingenuity#553.dst: Sizi birkaç gruba ayıracağım ve festivalden önce tamamlanması gereken görevler vereceğim.
The Price of Ingenuity#553.speaker: Syndra

The Price of Ingenuity#554.src: The decision Quill and I have come to is that I alone will be going for the kill. That way, if anything goes wrong... no one else faces the consequences.
The Price of Ingenuity#554.dst: Quill ile vardığımız karar şu: öldürme işini yalnızca ben yapacağım. Böylece bir şeyler ters giderse... sonuçlarına başka kimse katlanmaz.
The Price of Ingenuity#554.speaker: Syndra

The Price of Ingenuity#555.src: I'll go over the details tomorrow. I think... we've had enough excitement today. Please, hold your complaints until then, as well.
The Price of Ingenuity#555.dst: Ayrıntıları yarın anlatacağım. Bence... bugünlük bu kadar heyecan yeter. Lütfen şikâyetlerinizi de o zamana kadar saklayın.
The Price of Ingenuity#555.speaker: Syndra

The Price of Ingenuity#556.src: Ahem. Yes, indeed. I suppose we should be getting to dinner, as well.
The Price of Ingenuity#556.dst: Öhöm. Evet, kesinlikle. Sanırım biz de akşam yemeğine geçsek iyi olur.
The Price of Ingenuity#556.speaker: Quill

The Price of Ingenuity#557.src: Yuman... this may be unfair of me to ask, but would you be willing to play us a song tonight? We will not have many days left together.
The Price of Ingenuity#557.dst: Yuman... bunu istemem haksızlık olabilir ama bu gece bize bir şarkı çalar mısın? Birlikte çok günümüz kalmadı.
The Price of Ingenuity#557.speaker: Quill

The Price of Ingenuity#558.src: Yeah... yeah, man, of course. I can do that.
The Price of Ingenuity#558.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#559.src: Then let us enjoy the remainder of our company!
The Price of Ingenuity#559.dst: O hâlde birlikteliğimizin geri kalanının tadını çıkaralım!
The Price of Ingenuity#559.speaker: Quill

The Price of Ingenuity#561.src: Hey, everyone! Man, uh... small crowd today, huh?
The Price of Ingenuity#561.dst: Selam, millet! Dostum, şey... bugün kalabalık az, ha?
The Price of Ingenuity#561.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#562.src: Oh, man, is that Jiro I see? Hey, man! I didn't, uh... expect to see ya.
The Price of Ingenuity#562.dst: Ah, dostum, o gördüğüm Jiro mu? Selam, dostum! Şey... seni görmeyi beklemiyordum.
The Price of Ingenuity#562.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#564.src: Uh, just, you didn't seem super happy with me after... after yesterday. With the- soldier thing.
The Price of Ingenuity#564.dst: Şey, sadece, dünkü... dünkü şeyden sonra bana pek memnun görünmüyordun. Şu- asker meselesi.
The Price of Ingenuity#564.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#565.src: ... Oh! Yeah. No worries. Water under the bridge.
The Price of Ingenuity#565.dst: ... Ah! Evet. Dert etme. Olan oldu, geçti.
The Price of Ingenuity#565.speaker: Jiro

The Price of Ingenuity#566.src: If... if you say so! Don't think you've heard this one before, so tell me how you like it!
The Price of Ingenuity#566.dst: Sen... sen öyle diyorsan! Bunu daha önce duyduğunu sanmıyorum, beğenip beğenmediğini söyle!
The Price of Ingenuity#566.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#567.src: But first... Yus. Yusanu. Look, I... I'm not one to hold grudges. So I don't need any more apologies from you! I get it.
The Price of Ingenuity#567.dst: Ama önce... Yus. Yusanu. Bak, ben... kin tutan biri değilim. O yüzden senden başka özür beklemiyorum! Anlıyorum.
The Price of Ingenuity#567.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#568.src: I just... want you to trust us more, 'kay? You and Yulie both, haha! 'Cause... I want to help!
The Price of Ingenuity#568.dst: Sadece... bize daha çok güvenmeni istiyorum, tamam mı? Hem sen hem Yulie, haha! Çünkü... yardım etmek istiyorum!
The Price of Ingenuity#568.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#569.src: I had a think, and yeah. It sucks you didn't tell us. But your deal with Soosu- it saved us! Gave us a home, gave us a future!
The Price of Ingenuity#569.dst: Biraz düşündüm ve evet. Bize söylememen berbat. Ama Soosu'yla anlaşman- bizi kurtardı! Bize bir yuva verdi, bir gelecek verdi!
The Price of Ingenuity#569.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#570.src: So... this song's dedicated to you. Hope you like it.
The Price of Ingenuity#570.dst: Yani... bu şarkı sana gelsin. Umarım beğenirsin.
The Price of Ingenuity#570.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#571.src: No... no no no no no, where is it, where IS IT?! I can't... I need to find it, I-
The Price of Ingenuity#571.dst: Hayır... hayır hayır hayır hayır hayır, nerede, NEREDE?! Ben... onu bulmam lazım, ben-
The Price of Ingenuity#571.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#573.src: EEP! Y- your Majesty, I- I- I wasn't expecting you until... tomorrow. Wh- what're you doing here?
The Price of Ingenuity#573.dst: İİH! M- Majesteleri, b- b- ben sizi... yarın bekliyordum. B- burada ne yapıyorsunuz?
The Price of Ingenuity#573.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#574.src: My schedule freed up, so I decided to check in early. Is something wrong, Sovereign?
The Price of Ingenuity#574.dst: Programım boşaldı, ben de erkenden bir bakayım dedim. Bir sorun mu var, Hükümdar?
The Price of Ingenuity#574.speaker: Her Majesty

The Price of Ingenuity#576.src: Don't bother. How incompetent must you be, to have lost it from your own workshop?!
The Price of Ingenuity#576.dst: Zahmet etme. Onu kendi atölyende kaybedecek kadar beceriksiz misin?!
The Price of Ingenuity#576.speaker: Her Majesty

The Price of Ingenuity#577.src: I- I- I don't understand how, my golems haven't been disturbed! They didn't detect anything!
The Price of Ingenuity#577.dst: B- b- ben nasıl olduğunu anlamıyorum, golemlerime dokunulmamış! Hiçbir şey fark etmediler!
The Price of Ingenuity#577.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#578.src: Perhaps if you focused more on efficiency instead of playing around with your toys, this could have been prevented.
The Price of Ingenuity#578.dst: Belki oyuncaklarınla oynamak yerine verimliliğe daha çok odaklansaydın bu önlenebilirdi.
The Price of Ingenuity#578.speaker: Her Majesty

The Price of Ingenuity#579.src: I'll- I'll fix this, I promise! I promise I promise I promise, I can fix it! I can... I can restart! I still have all the research notes, and I-
The Price of Ingenuity#579.dst: Ben- ben düzelteceğim, söz veriyorum! Söz söz söz, düzeltebilirim! Ben... baştan başlayabilirim! Bütün araştırma notları hâlâ bende ve ben-
The Price of Ingenuity#579.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#580.src: Enough. I have been lenient with your performance maintaining your district, because I had faith there would be results.
The Price of Ingenuity#580.dst: Yeter. Bir sonuç çıkacağına inandığım için bölgeni yönetmedeki performansına karşı hoşgörülü davrandım.
The Price of Ingenuity#580.speaker: Her Majesty

The Price of Ingenuity#581.src: Restarting the Resonance Weaver project... it cannot be done. That artifact I entrusted you with... that magic is a lost art. It cannot be replicated.
The Price of Ingenuity#581.dst: Resonance Weaver projesini baştan başlatmak... mümkün değil. Sana emanet ettiğim o eser... o büyü kaybolmuş bir sanat. Kopyalanamaz.
The Price of Ingenuity#581.speaker: Her Majesty

The Price of Ingenuity#582.src: N- no, I have the notes, I- I know how it works, I can do it, just- just give me a chance! I can fix this!
The Price of Ingenuity#582.dst: H- hayır, notlar bende, b- ben nasıl çalıştığını biliyorum, yapabilirim, sadece- sadece bana bir şans verin! Bunu düzeltebilirim!
The Price of Ingenuity#582.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#583.src: I must prepare for the festival. I will expect your presence there, as usual. Please... clean yourself up before that.
The Price of Ingenuity#583.dst: Festivale hazırlanmam lazım. Her zamanki gibi orada olmanı bekliyorum. Lütfen... ondan önce kendine bir çeki düzen ver.
The Price of Ingenuity#583.speaker: Her Majesty

The Price of Ingenuity#586.src: Consider our agreement null. You have failed me. You will continue your service as Sovereign indefinitely... with your blessing intact.
The Price of Ingenuity#586.dst: Anlaşmamızı geçersiz say. Beni hayal kırıklığına uğrattın. Hükümdar olarak hizmetine süresiz devam edeceksin... kutsaman olduğu gibi kalarak.
The Price of Ingenuity#586.speaker: Her Majesty

The Price of Ingenuity#587.src: ...what? No- no, no no no, you- you can't, you can't, you can't!!!!
The Price of Ingenuity#587.dst: ...ne? Hayır- hayır, hayır hayır hayır, siz- yapamazsınız, yapamazsınız, yapamazsınız!!!!
The Price of Ingenuity#587.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#589.src: Rest for the night in your room in the Steel Feather at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

The Price of Ingenuity#591.src: You all go and meet up, now. I have much to discuss with Quill.
The Price of Ingenuity#591.dst: Siz gidin, buluşun bakalım. Benim Quill ile konuşacak çok şeyim var.
The Price of Ingenuity#591.speaker: Syndra

The Price of Ingenuity#592.src: Training's a pretty good option, all things considered. Let's go before I forget how to string my bow!
The Price of Ingenuity#592.dst: Her şey düşünülünce eğitim gayet iyi bir seçenek. Yayıma kiriş takmayı unutmadan gidelim!
The Price of Ingenuity#592.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#593.src: Mmmmm. That bread was really tasty...
The Price of Ingenuity#593.dst: Mmmmm. O ekmek gerçekten çok lezzetliydi...
The Price of Ingenuity#593.speaker: Sui

The Price of Ingenuity#594.src: Maybe once we're done training, I should bake another loaf...
The Price of Ingenuity#594.dst: Belki eğitim bitince bir somun daha pişirmeliyim...
The Price of Ingenuity#594.speaker: Sui

The Price of Ingenuity#595.src: The re- reason I got to bed s- so- so late tonight was be- because I'd been up late tr- training...
The Price of Ingenuity#595.dst: Bu gece y- yatağa o- o- o kadar geç girmemin s- sebebi, geç saate kadar e- eğitim yapıyor olmamdı...
The Price of Ingenuity#595.speaker: Zeph

The Price of Ingenuity#596.src: I only ha- have a f- fl- flicker of magic... I don't want it to sn- snuff out.
The Price of Ingenuity#596.dst: Bende sadece b- bir k- kı- kıvılcım kadar büyü var... S- sönüp gitmesini istemiyorum.
The Price of Ingenuity#596.speaker: Zeph

The Price of Ingenuity#597.src: Ah, to train first thing in the morning!
The Price of Ingenuity#597.dst: Ah, sabahın ilk ışığında eğitim yapmak!
The Price of Ingenuity#597.speaker: Mora

The Price of Ingenuity#598.src: It's no smithing, perhaps, but still a fantastic way to work up a sweat!
The Price of Ingenuity#598.dst: Demircilik kadar olmasa da ter dökmenin yine de harika bir yolu!
The Price of Ingenuity#598.speaker: Mora

The Price of Ingenuity#599.src: If you're reading this note, please turn around!
The Price of Ingenuity#599.dst: Bu notu okuyorsan lütfen geri dön!
